## Summary
- P0 IDE product path: ConPTY stream owner, async inference UI marshal, Problems/output channel wiring.
- Keeps four-panel IDE completion evidence on this branch only; do not inherit PASS from other executables.
- Separate from AgentSession and ExtensionHost PRs until each passes its own gates.

## Scope (this PR only)
- Validate four-panel IDE, ConPTY, inference, Problems, and output wiring.
- Compile, link, launch, and exercise those subsystems on a SHA-specific binary.
- Preserve frozen daily-driver baseline `A4F083DFΓÇª` (no regression).

## Explicit non-claims
- `PROMOTE=0`
- `CERTIFIED=0`
- Opening this PR does **not** authorize merge.
- Prior Finish-25 authority remains **19/25** until new SHA-specific evidence changes it.
- 330 MB tip dumps and temporary generated files must stay out of Git.

## Test plan
- [ ] Clean build + link of Win32IDE from this branch tip
- [ ] Launch IDE; confirm ConPTY terminal start/stop/resize/interrupt paths
- [ ] Exercise async inference UI marshal (stream tokens, cancel, no worker HWND use)
- [ ] Verify Problems aggregator dedupe + Output channel routing (`Build` / panel tabs)
- [ ] Confirm no regression vs frozen baseline `A4F083DFΓÇª`
- [ ] Record SHA-specific evidence; do not copy PASS from another executable
- [ ] Leave `PROMOTE=0` / `CERTIFIED=0` until independently validated

## Integration order
1. This PR (IDE Product Path)
2. AgentSession GUI (separate PR)
3. ExtensionHost Runtime (separate PR)
4. Only after all three merge + pass: unified full-feature candidate ΓåÆ Finish-25 ΓåÆ release audit
